mapper.select: SELECT scenario_version_no, scenario_no, version_no, status, start_node_no, frst_regr_empno, published_at, frst_reg_dt FROM tb_scenario_version WHERE scenario_no = #{scenarioId} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT scenario_version_no, scenario_no, version_no, status, start_node_no, frst_regr_empno, published_at, frst_reg_dt FROM tb_scenario_version WHERE scenario_no = #{scenarioId} AND status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT scenario_version_no, scenario_no, version_no, status, start_node_no, frst_regr_empno, published_at, frst_reg_dt FROM tb_scenario_version WHERE scenario_no = #{scenarioId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_scenario_version (scenario_no, version_no, status, frst_regr_empno) VALUES (#{scenarioNo}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, #{frstRegrEmpno})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_scenario_version SET status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE scenario_no = #{scenarioId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE tb_scenario_version SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = now() WHERE scenario_version_no = #{id}
